evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected AbilityActionData dispatcher tag, generated wrapper member names and types, checked formatter and complete source reader bytes, signed action-list count and two terminal stores, plus replay of original logical bytes to the child span endpoint.
evidenceBoundary.direct: A one-action SequenceActionData child stores CheckDamageDecorateMask members in the selected source read order.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Enum values, mask bits, and terminal bytes are stored values; no runtime predicate outcome is inferred.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Other condition action tags, other damage processors, live formatter choice, and any enclosing BuffData root not independently replayed to EOF.
